answer: Reputation decay punishes idle hoarding, because a score below the working threshold loses its rewards. Each identity begins at 100 points, and after 2 idle epochs it loses 8 per epoch, while honest work restores 6, so a lagoon of clones drains steadily. A fable of hoarding fails: 1,000 clones cost 3,000 units per epoch to maintain, and within 5 idle epochs each falls below 60 and stops earning, so bulk forgery becomes a glacier of slow loss.
